staticChecks.finding: The initial main assertion requires a binding dict before reading inputs, invoking Git, creating Q or copying evidence. There is no default fallback or product runtime invocation. Future subprocess calls are read-only Git metadata queries.

Fixed inputs require exact path/size/hash pins. Closed/frozen journal identity, unique root phases, source anchors, normal group exits, exact allowed nonzero exits and required independent probe/original commands are checked.

Requires final review allReadsFinished, empty blocking list and formalAcceptanceClosed=false, plus root outcome bound to the journal/control/review. Final review must establish deeper actual evidence/source attribution; template checks do not replace it.

Primary test receipt requires 16 original passed identities with no pending/todo. Generator 38/75, nine outside-layout A4 JSONs, probe modes, root records and nested seven strip-control/three failed-control child records remain separate counts.

Successful strip-control result/restoration/native equality and all seven expected normal 0/1 exits are required. Earlier literal-control ACTIVE/HALTED, missing final result and first three child exits0/0/2 are mandatory. The prose explicitly leaves literal-passthrough acceptance open.

Selected files must be regular non-symlink files outside product root, git and node_modules. Sensitive key suffixes and .env filenames are refused. Traversal is limited to top-level metadata and explicit closed command/phase sidecars; homes/stores/tmp/pages/copies/mutant-inputs are not traversed.

Manifest paths, named tracked/compiled/physical/Pages manifests, runtime-artifact indices and files larger than1MiB stay private unsplit references. No source/dist/fixture body copies or chunking are introduced. Parent8751 tracked+4529 compiled hashes/modes are checked before writes.

Q must be absent and under the expected qualification parent, source/branch/clean Git must match, all writes are exclusive and bounded per file, no deletion or cleanup exists. Receipt artifact hashes are computed before receipt itself, avoiding a self-hash cycle. Final status permits only the new qualification namespace.
